claim_boundary: The interrupted full runs identify scale bottlenecks and the local gates verify their corrections. This artifact is not a terminal full-scale performance result.

observed.blocked_operation: mkdir on journal.objects content-addressed payload path

immutable_origin_metadata.cause: Every materialized task decoded, hashed, and registered the same inline stage payload again. The deduplicated object-store path still issued shared-filesystem mkdir/stat metadata RPCs while Runtime owned the Manager lane.
immutable_origin_metadata.correction: Cache one immutable object ticket per workflow DataID; the full workload now performs three object registrations rather than one per task.

sparse_library_iteration.cause: Worker current_libraries used global physical task IDs as sparse keys. Scheduling paths iterated that table to find one library and count credits, making each decision O(max_physical_task_id) and total scheduling cost trend quadratic.
sparse_library_iteration.correction: Retain the sparse table for direct task-ID lookup and maintain a dense per-worker library list for all iterations, reducing those paths to O(libraries_per_worker).

acceptance_gate_corrections.physical_parallelism: Use the Runtime-advertised bounded physical submission window instead of requiring 32768 Manager-visible tasks from a 4096-view Runtime.
acceptance_gate_corrections.worker_churn: Require submissions equals completions equals logical tasks plus infrastructure retries plus recovery replays, successful normal task reports equals logical tasks, and non-infrastructure failures equals zero.

peer_transfer_and_recovery_head_of_line.cause: A consumer resolved a peer replica and the source Worker disconnected before transfer completion. The Worker Agent left the local object in FETCHING instead of faulting and resolving again. Controller queued agent-side last-replica losses, but Runtime watched only a separate Manager-side counter. With 4096 consumers occupying the physical window, no producer replay could enter even after loss delivery.
peer_transfer_and_recovery_head_of_line.correction: Report the exact source worker/session/token tuple, make duplicate fault reports idempotent, deliver one Controller-owned loss event stream to Runtime, keep 2048 recovery slots above the ordinary 4096 window, and prioritize recovery producers. A saturated Manager now avoids rebuilding scheduling heaps and empty replication queues.

worker_disconnect_fault_gate.injection: SIGTERM one of four 2-core Workers at 2070 physical completions
worker_disconnect_fault_gate.note: The raw performance summary is FAIL only because the deliberate loss makes the uninterrupted 8-of-8 active-core gate false; every correctness, recovery, data-path, and physical-conservation gate passes.

verification.direct_agent_protocol: PASS, including exact and idempotent remote faults
